tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// mchod sbyin tshogs gsog gi rim pa yid bzhin nor bu'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ dza la ba liṃ bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ chu gtor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dad pa can gang zhig gis las su bya ba la phan yon che la sla ba ni chu gtor yin pas 'di la brtson par bya'o// de la rin po che'i snod mdzes pa'i nang du chu blugs la phye dang me tog la sogs pa ci 'byor pa dang*/ gser la sogs pa rin po che rnam pa lnga brdar ba dang*/ kha zas ma smas pa ma smos pa sna tshogs dang*/ sman dang 'bru dang dri la sogs pa sbyar na lhag par yang bzang ngo*// spyir gtor ma'i las bgyi'o 'tshal la brtag pa drug ste sbyang ba la sogs pa'o// de la sbyang ba ni chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas so// spel ba ni nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas so// mos par bsgyur ba ni bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas so// spyod pa la dbang ba ni rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas so// thob par byed pa ni ye shes skar mda'i sngags dang phyag rgyas so// dbang du bya ba ni lha mgon spyi'i sngags dang phyag rgyas te dbang sgyur 'khor lo'i sngags dang phyag rgyas so// de la bsam rgyud ni dang por bdag nyid lus bsrung zhing lha'i sku phyag rgya chen por dran pa bskyed la/ tshad med pa bzhis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol zhing snying rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don dran par bya'o// bsngo ba yang bla na med pa'i byang chub chen por bsngo bar bya ste/ de yang dmigs kyi bsngo ba ni sri zhu'i mgron sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ nyan thos rang rgyal la sogs pa dang*/ yon tan gyi mgron tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu dang srung ma dam tshig can rnams dang*/

snying rje'i mgron 'gro ba ris drug gi sems can dang*/ khyad par du yang bdag gi lha mgon dang*/ yul gang na gnas pa'i sa bdag lha klu dang*/ lan chags kyi mgron tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i rkyen bgegs dang*/ phan gnod byed pa'i lha 'dre kun la yang mnyam snyoms su bsngo bar bya'o// de la dang po lag pa thal mo khong stong du sbyar la 'di skad du brjod do// oṃ swa bhā ba bi shud+dhaḥsarba dhar+m+māḥswa bhā ba bi shud+dhohaṃ/ lag pa thal mo khong stong du sbyar la sor mo rnams rtse sprad de tshigs zur can rin po che lta bur byas la sngags 'di brjod do// na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ lag pa thal mo sbyar la phyir bskyed de mthe bong gnyis bsnol la sngags 'di brjod do// oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje khur tshur bcangs la mdzub mo bsgrengs te sngags 'di brjod do// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje khur tshur snying gar bstan la/ g.yon pas mchog sbyin gyis snod 'degs pa'i tshul du byas te sngags 'di brjod do// oṃ dzñā na a ba lo ki te sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha ba sa ma ya mahā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐/ lag pa thal mo khong stong du sbyar la/ sor mo rnams nang du bsnol te mthe bong gnyis gshibs te brkyangs la sngags 'di brjod do// na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ gra he shwa ra pra bha dz+yo ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'di gcig la yang lan bdun bdun bzlas so// de yang dang pos ni gtor ma skyon med cing dag pa chen por byin gyis brlab/ gnyis pas ni mchod pa'i rdzas kyi khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi mos pa ji lta ba bzhin nam mkha'i khams 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas gang bar byin gyis brlab bo// de ltar spel nas gsum pas ni bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang*/

zas la sogs pa longs spyod la ji ltar so sor mos pa bzhin du longs spyod kyi rkyen dug lnga'i gsos dang*/ ye shes lngar byin gyis brlab bo// bzhi pas ni 'phags pa rnams kyi spyan lam du yang gzhal med khang brtsegs ma la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung mang por sprul nas mchod pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi dbang po'i spyod yul du ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga char bzhin du 'byung bar bsam zhing*/ khyad par du yang yi dwags kyi rnam pa mang po dang sems can kun gyi bsam pa yongs su skong bar byin gyis brlab bo// lnga pas ni bdag gi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa phul nas mnyes pa dang*/ sems can la byin pas pham rgyal med pa dang 'thab rtsod med pa so so'i mos pa bzhin thob par byin gyis brlab bo// drug pas ni sri zhu'i mgron dang*/ yon tan gyi mgron dang*/ snying rje'i mgron dang*/ lan chags kyi mgron du gyur pa'i rigs la yang dam tshig gi dbang gis 'go zhing stong grogs gyur par mngon sum du dmigs so// sems can gyi don du 'gyur ba'i las mi 'gal bar ci bcol ba yang 'grub ste phyag rgya yang phyogs bcur bstan la dbang du bya'o// de nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis kyang bsngo bar bya'o// gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rgyal po 'di// chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*// dkon mchog yon tan dpag med che ba dang*// snying po phyag rgya nges pa'i dam tshig dang*// rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa'i nus mthu dang*// drang srong rig 'dzin rnams kyi grub pa dang*// bdag gi smon lam ting 'dzin shes rab kyis// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// dbang po lnga yi longs spyod mkho dgur ldan// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gter chen gyur pa 'di// mchod gnas bla ma khyed kyi pho brang du// mchod pa'i sprin gyis rgyas shing 'phel bar bsngo// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig

/kun kyang gnod pa rnams dang bral// yang ni de bzhin gshegs bsngags pa'i// 'dod pa phun sum tshogs gyur cig /yang ni sems can thams cad kyang*// bsam pa yid bzhin grub gyur cig /byol song gcig la gcig za ba'i// gnod pa de dag yongs ma 'byung*// yi dwags rnams la zas skom sogs// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gang*// mi bzad rnam pa sna tshogs pa// bsod nams byin pa'i byin rlabs kyis// de dag myur du zhi gyur cig /sa'am mkha' la 'khod pa yi// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// 'byung po mang po gang 'khod pa// dge ba'i bsam pa rdzogs gyur cig /de nas chos kyi sbyin pa yang rgya cher bya'o// chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs// de la 'gog pa gang yin pa// dge sbyong chen pos de skad gsungs// sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes bya ba la sogs pa zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa mang pos chos dang zang zing gnyis su med pa'i sbyin pa rgya chen por bya'o// de ltar chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa rnam pa gnyis kyis sgrib pa rnam pa gnyis byang tshogs gnyis rdzogs te bla na med pa'i byang chub 'grub par shes par bya'o// slob dpon dza ya se nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// ༈ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan pas mdzad pa'i gtor ma brgya rtsa la lhan thabs dkyus su bcug pa lhag bsam 'od dkar bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yab// khams gsum sems can bu bzhin skyong ba'i ma// srid gsum yid kyi mun pa sel mdzad pa'i// mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bla sogs mkha' sogs dge sbyong sogs// lhan sogs gzhi sogs 'brog gnas sogs// bgegs sogs rigs drug yi dwags sogs// gnod byed ma thob rnams la sbyin// las dang po pa rnams la phan par bya ba'i phyir/

gtor ma brgya rtsa gtong ba'i tshul/ brjod par bya'o// de la'ang gtor zan gtsang ma la/ dkar gsum dang*/ mngar gsum la sogs pa yod na sbag chu gtsang ma dang*/ gtor snod bcu'am lnga/ bum pa sogs snod dang bcas pa sta gon byas la/ zan sum tshan gsum dang*/ nyis tshan gcig gis brgya rtsa brgyad du bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs// stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ zhes pa nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ ting shag brdung zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi sogs lan gsum brjod/ bdag dang 'gro ba zhes sogs skyabs 'gro ci nus byas te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po phul la 'phags pa rnams mnyes shing rigs drug rnams chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshim par bya/ zhes lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid skad cig gi 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/

ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes sngags rgyas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa sngags rgyas spyan drang*/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ thugs ka'i hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad jo bo thugs rje chen po'i skyabs 'og tu tshud par gyur cig skyabs kyi dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skyes nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma'i mgron du gyur pa thams cad rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ ting shag dang*/ na mo bde gshegs snying po 'gro kun yongs la khyab// sems ni rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed de// 'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu// 'di na snod min sems can gang yang med// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha// dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis ni// sems can don la dgongs pa'i dkon mchog gsum// yid kyis sprul zhing bshams pa'i gnas 'di ru// gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rgyal po la// rgyal ba rgyal sras nyan thos rang rgyal dang*// lha srin sde brgyad 'gro drug sems can rnams// bgegs rnams gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin la// spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/

pad+ma'i phyag rgyas gdan phul/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// yi dam lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas// dkon mchog rnam gsum chos skyong srung ma la// lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam par rab sprul nas// rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// ting shag dang*/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang*// bdug spos snang gsal dri mchog dang*// zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa// mchod rdzas ji snyed yod pa rnams// bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di// ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pa nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar la mchod/ ting shag dang*/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sel byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*// mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la// rin chen me tog la sogs char// rgyun mi chad pa 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos mchod// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag las// nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas la// mchod sprin rgya mtsho nam mkha' mnyam pas mchod// thog med dus nas bdag gis sdig pa'i las// bag med bgyis gang 'dren pa'i spyan sngar bshags// brtse chen rgyal dang byang chub sems sogs kyis// don chen dge ba mdzad la rjes yi rangs// ma dag 'khor ba'i bya bas ldongs rnams la// rnam dag chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// thub mchog mya ngan 'da' bar gang bzhed la// skyes mchog de dag bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// bsam yas dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan// mtha' yas 'gro bas byang chub thob phyir bsngo// zhes yan lag bdun pa phul la/

zhal zas la sogs pa bsdu zhing*/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// bdag cag dad pa'i stobs kyis 'bul lags kyis// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /ces brjod la chu sbyin ni/ chu dang snod zas kyis ma gos par byas la/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// sogs nas skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig bar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o// tshar grangs yin na mi g.yo ba dang*/ sgrol ma/ klu dang*/ su rū pa ste dkar gtor cha bzhi zur nas 'byung ba ltar dbul/ bya spyod shas che ba'i lha tshe dpag med dang*/ 'jam dbyangs/ 'od zer can ma lta bu la sgos gtor 'bul bar mos na'ang mi g.yo ba dang sgrol ma'i gong 'og gang 'os su mdor bsdus te dbul lo// de nas dzam ser nag la chu 'bul ba ni/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dzam̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ 'phags pa dzam+bha la sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas bī dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon pas rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis dung dang pad+ma'i gter mnan pa/ ut+pal sngon po'i phreng ba dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i dbus su dzam̐ yig gser po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'phags pa dzam+bha la'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan gtso bor gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbur brgyan/ lag mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bh+rūm̐ ām̐ dz+rīṃ kham̐ hūm̐ las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu ba dang lhan cig 'dres pa'i chu mdzub mo brkyangs pa las babs par gyur/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa dang*/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'char mang po kun gyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam+bha la// dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// ser sna'i las kyi me yis gdungs pa rnams// skye dang skye bar khyed la skyabs su mchi// rin chen bdud rtsi'i gter gyi char rgyun gyis// sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod// yang bsang sbyang sogs nas/ zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ mgon po dzam+bha la sku mdog nag po mi'u thung gi gzugs can gsus pa 'phyang ba/ gcer bu rna ba ma phug pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas na thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang*/ g.yon na rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis nor bdag ser po rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa gan rkyal du bsgyel zhing kha nas rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa mnan pa/ sku las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas/ hūm̐ las 'od zer sogs nas mgon po dzam+bha la yi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥsogs nas/

chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ in+d+ra ni mu khaṃ bh+ra ma ri swā hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ dza luṃ swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsas chu 'bul lo// na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha drā ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa gong bzhin dang*/ oṃ dza luṃ ba liṃ ta sogs kyis phul/ oṃ dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ mgon po nam mkha'i mdog can nor gyi char 'bebs pa// ma skyes rang bzhin dag pas sku mdog sngon por bzhugs// khyod ni rdo rje sems dpa' nyid de bdag dran na// rtag tu yid la re ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// dzam+bha la sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes dngos grub kyi don du chu lce la bzhag bdag dang sems can thams cad la log pa'i 'tsho ba ma yin pa'i chos dang mthun pa'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ dzam bha la dkar dmar sogs la chu 'bul na'ang skabs 'dir rang rang gi gzhung bzhin bya'o// de nas brgya rtsa la 'jug ste zan ril bcu tshan bcu dang brgyad byas la bcu tshan dang po chus sbyangs te/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma lha'i bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ zhes nyer gcig dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ zhes pa nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ ting shag dang*/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos dkon mchog

dge 'dun dkon mchog dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rgyu sbyor bas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ gnyis pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum dang*/ sam+bha ra nyer gcig oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la sogs pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu la sogs pa/ dpal gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam la btags shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che skyong ba/ dpal rdo rje gdan gyis gtso byas rgya gar dang*/ bod kyi gtsug lag khang dang*/ gdan sa khyad par can rnams skyong zhing*/ bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba'i lha klu 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag bla ma yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag chos sgrub pa 'khor bcas kyi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las byung ba dang mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa dang*/ rkyen phyi dang nang gi bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gsum pa/ yang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum sogs sngar dang 'dra zhing*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams dang*/ dge sbyong da nga*/ bram ze dang*/ lha'i drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/

tshig tsam gyis phan 'dogs nus pa/ smon lam gyi sa la dbang ba/ dmod pa 'dor nus pa rnams la 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can rnams bde zhing skyid pa dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rgyu sbyor ba 'khor bcas kyi chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing mthun rkyen chos bzhin 'grub pa'i smon lam bzang po gdab tu gsol/ bzhi pa yang sngar dang 'dra zhing*/ bdag cag 'gro ba rnams kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i lha dang*/ rnam thos sras dang*/ dzam+bha la dang*/ nor rgyun ma dang*/ tshogs kyi bdag po la sogs pa nor lha'i tshogs rnams dang*/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srung skyob mdzad pa'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// nad dang*/ dbul ba dang*/ phongs pa dang*/ 'jigs pa med pa dang*/ tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ lnga pa man chod la 'bru gsum lan gsum re dang*/ sam+bha ra bdun re/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byam klas la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod pas 'gre zhing*/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma sogs/ rdo rje gdan gyis gtso byas pa'i 'dzam bu gling gi gzhi'i bdag po rnams dang*/ khyad par du bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis dang*/ sgos dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ bye brag tu yul phyogs dang*/ sa cha 'di nyid na gnas pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ btsan dang*/ bdud dang*/ sa bdag gnyan mthu bo che/ gzhi bdag gnas bdag rnams la 'bul lo// 'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su phebs pa dang*/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang*/ mi nad dang*/ phyugs nad dang*/ mu ge dang*/ 'khrugs pa rnams zhi zhing mi 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ drug pa/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gang ba bzang po dang*/ nor bu bzang po la sogs pa 'brog gnas mched lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/

gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes dang*/ rgyal ba khyu mchog la sogs pa phyogs mtshams srung bar byed pa'i gnod sbyin nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ gnod sbyin mthu bo che gsum cu rtsa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ 'phrog ma bu lnga brgya 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ 'brog gnas mched kyi tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// sems can gyi srog dang*/ gzi brjid dang*/ mdangs 'phrog pa la sogs pa gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa zhi zhing*/ khyad par du'ang bdag cag chos sgrub pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag zhi nas/ chos dang mthun pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bdun pa/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ nad bdag rims bdag yams kyi bdag mo gdug pa can gnod byed kyi tshogs/ sa dang bar snang la gnas nas 'dod pa'i bgegs byed cing mi 'dod pa skyed par byed pa rnams la sbyin no// deng phyin chad bsam ngan dug rtsub dang gnod 'tshe thams cad zhi zhing*/ gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skye bar gyur cig bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la'ang gnod pa'i bsam pa bsal nas phan sems dang ldan par gyur cig brgyad pa/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la sbyin na/ rigs drug so so'i lan chags bu lon byang zhing*/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral te/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug rim gyis rdzogs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po myur du thob par gyur cig dgu pa/ yi dwags kyi rgyal mo kha la me 'bar ma la sogs phyi'i sgrib pa can dang*/ nang gi sgrib pa can dang*/ me lce'i 'khor lo can dang*/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can dang mkha' la rgyu ba dang klung na gnas pa dang bying na gnas pa dang kha 'thor gyi tshogs bkres skom dang dbul phongs kyis bsdus pa mtha' dag la sbyin no// so so'i mdun du zas skom bdud rtsi'i char chen po phab nas/

lus dang sems la phan pa dang*/ bde bas longs spyod cing tshim par gyur cig ser sna'i sdig sgrib byang zhing*/ yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal dang bral nas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myur du rdzogs pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig bcu pa/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rgyu sbyor ba 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas lan chags kyi mgron bu lon ma khyer ba dang*/ tshe 'dir yang thugs zur dang spyan zur la phog pa rnams dang*/ gnod byed kyi tshogs ngos ma zin pa rnams la sbyin no// lan chags thams cad byang*/ bu lon thams cad khyer ba dang*/ phrag dog tu gyur pa dang*/ gnod byed kyi tshogs rnams gtor ma 'dis mnyes shing re ba thams cad skong bar gyur cig bcu gcig pa/ ma thob pa/ ma slebs pa/ kha zhan cing dbang chung ba/ gtor ma la re ba/ glo bur du lhags pa'i 'byung po rnams dang*/ skal ba chad pa/ kha zhan pa/ dbang chung ba/ lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// so sor zas skom gyis tshims nas/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces brjod do// stong rtsa'am 'bum ther ni sngar gyi cho gas lan stong ngam/ 'bum sogs su dbul lo// de nas bar do'i gtor ma ni/ lnga pa ltar bsngos la/ mdang da nangs shi ba'i mi phyugs dus la nye ba gcig gis gtsor byas/ srid pa bar do na gnas pa rnams la sbyin no// bar do'i 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang nyam nga ba thams cad dang bral nas/ bar do la bar dor ngo shes/ bar do'i lam mngon du gyur/ bar dor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces brjod do// de nas dbyu gu'i gtor ma ni zan drug cu rtsa bzhi byas la/ snga ma ltar bsang sbyang*/ byin gyis brlab pa nas/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ oṃ a kā ro sogs drug cu rtsa bzhi pa phul nas/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma dam pa 'dis// 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mnyes pa dang*// dam can thugs dam bskang ba dang*// lan chags bu lon khyer ba dang*// rigs drug sems can tshim byas nas// bla med byang chub myur thob shog

/gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi 'di mkha' 'gro ma drug cu rtsa bzhi la phul bas rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi mnyes shing tshim par gyur cig dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dus kyi bar chad thams cad zhi nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ brul gtor gtong bar 'dod na/ gtor snod gsum du mtheb kyu gsum gsum bcug ste/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma lha'i bdud rtsi zhes pa nas yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsol bar bsam zhing*/ sam+bha ra nyer gcig gis phul/ de nas zan brul dang chu blugs shing ma ṇi nyer gcig re bgrangs pas rin po che'i char 'babs nas/ de dag la phul bar bsgom/ rang gi lus gtor snod du rgyang bskyur nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas lus de bdud rtsir mer zhu/ de longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsol bar bsam zhing*/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod de/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phul bas/ mchod par bzhes nas dam pa'i chos kyi dkor la 'bags pa la sogs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad byang nas myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ gnyis pa rin po che'i snod du bsgom zhing*/ sprul sku'i sangs rgyas la 'bul tshul 'dra bar byas nas/ gtor ma 'di sprul pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa la phul bas/ mchod par bzhes nas dge 'dun gyi dkor la 'bags pa sogs gong ltar bya'o// gsum pa lan chags kyi rigs la sbyin te/ lus 'bul ba ma gtogs sngar bzhin byas nas/ gtor ma 'di tshe thog ma med pa nas lan chags pa rnams la ster bas lan chags thams cad khyer/

sha 'khon thams cad zhi nas myur du sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig 'di la mchod pa mi dgos/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ ye dharmā sogs dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste// ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin// yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste// thams cad du ni sdom pa legs// thams cad srung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med par// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// zhes chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ chu sbyin ni/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pas kha 'bar ma sogs yi dwags thams cad dang khyad par du 'jur 'gegs kyi las ngan rnams tshim par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ oṃ dza la mi daṃ sar+b+ba pre te bh+yaḥswā hā/ re re la yang lan bdun bdun/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi// phyag nas babs pa'i 'o rgyun gyis// yi dwags rnams ni tshim byas nas// khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog /ces dang*/ mgon po mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa raṃ pa rā ṇi me sar+b+ba satwā nāñtsa swāhā/ oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ki te/ na mas+saman+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi saṃ bha wa sa ma ya mahā ma ṇi/

du ru du ru hṛ da ya dz+wa la ni swā hā/ chu'i sbyin pa rgya chen po 'di la brten nas klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang*/ 'jog po dang*/ nye dga' bo la sogs pa srid pa chu klung gi bdag po rnams kyi rgyud la sbyin pa dam pa sems kyi rgyan du gyur cig sems kyi yo byad du gyur cig rnal 'byor gyi tshogs don gnyis kyi mchog rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod do// bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// zhes sogs bden stobs brjod do// skabs 'dir cha gsum gtor ma gtong na/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa ltar bya'o// yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskang zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzod// sogs kyi mthar badz+ra muḥ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa'i// 'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*// gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang*// sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa// mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su// thams cad thams cad 'gro bar gyis// sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/ sarba pre ta gats+tsha/ zhes pas mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ zhes brjod pas bsrung ba bya'o// ting shag dang*/ ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog

/'byung po gang dag sogs dang*/ nyin mo bde legs sogs bkra shis dang*/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// sogs kyi bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam gdab bo// de ltar byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi bzhed srol sil gtor brgya rtsa mar grags pa'i gzhung rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa 'di la kha skong lhan thabs kyi rigs mang du bzhugs pa las/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa 'di nyid stabs bde zhing*/ skyer sgang pa'i brul gtor yang tshang yod pa'i dbang gis dkyus su bcug gsal kha phran bu dang bcas te rgyal khams pa wā gin+d+ras bklags chog mar bsdebs pa'o// ༈ /mchod sbyin gtor ma'i rnal 'byor nyung gsal khyer bde tshogs gnyis lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru lo ke shwa rā ya/ 'dir tshegs chung zhing don che ba mchod sbyin gtor ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar 'dod pas gnas gtsang mar gtor ma'i yo byad rnams phyag len bzhin bsham/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ yig las// byung ba'i rin chen snod yangs su// mchod gtor dwangs shing thogs med pa// nam mkha'i khams kun khyab par gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs lan gsum brjod cing ting shag dkrol/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis skyabs sems dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang*/ hrīḥlas rang nyid 'phags mchog snying rje'i gter// zla mdog phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pad dkar// zhabs gnyis sems skyil pad zla'i gdan la rol// dar dang rin chen rgyan mdzes gsal bar gyur// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ci nus bzla/ rang nyid 'phags pa'i thugs nas 'od 'phros pas// bla ma mchog gsum yi dam chos srung dang*// bgegs rigs lan chags rigs drug bar do sogs// mchod sbyin mgron rnams badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pas spyan drang*/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ gyi gdan dbul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis spyir mchod/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ de nas chu sbyin ni/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ oṃ dza la mi daṃ sarba pre te bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes pas sbyin/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi// phyag nas babs pa'i 'o rgyun gyis// yi dwags rnams ni tshim byas nas// khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog /ces smon lam gdab/ dzam+bha la'i chu sbyin ni/ mdun du pad zla'i gdan steng rmugs 'dzin ser// phyag gnyis gang ba'i 'bras bu ne'u le bsnams// rin chen rgyan spras dung dang pad gter mnan// g.yon du rmugs 'dzin mthing nag thod pa dang*// ne'u le bsnams nas nor bdag gdan steng du// g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan// bdag gi lag mthil rigs lnga'i sa bon las// babs pa'i bdud rtsis mchog tu dges par gyur// oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ brgya rtsa/ oṃ in+d+ra nī mu khaṃ bh+ra ma rī swā hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ dzam+lum̐ swā hā/ brgya rtsas chu sbyin/ gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlab/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ dzam+lum̐ sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ sogs lan gsum gyis dbul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam+bha la// dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ dzam+bha la sid+dhi pha la hoḥzhes pas dngos grub blang*/ de nas brgya rtsa dngos la 'jug pa ni/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ yig las// byung ba'i rin chen snod yangs su// 'bru gsum 'od du zhu ba las// gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/

na mas+sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ gtor ma 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// byin rlabs 'byung gnas rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam zhi khro rgyal ba sras bcas sogs// skyabs gnas dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma dang*// bden tshig grub pa'i lha mi'i drang srong mchog /dgos 'dod char 'bebs nor lha'i tshogs bcas la// 'bul lo bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum/ sam+bha ra dang*/ bde gshegs rin chen mang dang gzugs dam pa// 'byams klas 'jigs kun bral la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gzhi bdag gnod sbyin sde// gdon bgegs 'byung po rigs drug snying rje'i yul// khyad par yi dwags 'gro dang lan chags mgron// lhag ma bshal chu re ba kun la bsngo// rtag tu phan bde'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cig /de nas dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis brlab/ a kā ro lan drug cu rtsa bzhis bsngos la/ gtor ma 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// rdo rje lha mo drug cu rtsa bzhi la// 'bul lo bzhes nas dbyu gu drug cu bzhi'i// dus kyi bar chad thams cad srung bar mdzod// de nas/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// zhes sogs kyis chos sbyin dang*/ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i// mchod sbyin yul gyur mgron kun gyis// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas phrin las gzhol/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs nas/ badz+ra muḥ sarba bhū ta gats+tshaḥsarba pre ta gats+tshaḥ zhes pas gtor mgron gshegs rang gi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par mos la/

dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// zhes sogs bsngo smon dang*/ ston mchog dam pa sogs shis pa brjod pa ji ltar rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// zhes pa'ang blo gros dman zhing rnam par g.yeng ba'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa rnams kyis dge tshogs rlabs po che myur du 'dums pa'i thabs mkhas 'di'ang bya bral ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi bla brang thar pa rtser sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i go 'phang la 'god par rgyur gyur cig sarba dā shre yo bha ba tu// ༈ /gtor ma cha lnga shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ phyogs skyong*/ rgyal chen/ 'byung po/ gzhi bdag bgegs kyi gtor ma rnams rgyud sde 'og ma'i cho ga'i yan lag las 'byung ba ltar shin tu bsdus te bya ba'i tshul ni/ rang nyid gnyug ma'i lha gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal la gnas pa'am/ bdag med pa gnyis kyi don la blo bzhag ste/ mchod gtor a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ a kā ros brlab pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dang po ni/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye his mgron dgug pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan 'bul/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gṛh+ṇe daṃ na mas+sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ 'jig rten skyong ba 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag sogs spyi ltar brjod pas phrin las gsol bar bya'o// des mtshon te/ gnyis pa ni/ oṃ tsa turmahā rā dzā se na sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ sngags mthar gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ na mas+sarba sogs btags pas mchod gtor 'bul/ mthu chen rgyal po sde bzhi rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs brjod/

gsum pa ni/ oṃ sarba lo ka kā ra sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ sngags mthar ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ na mas+sarba sogs btags pas mchod gtor 'bul/ 'jig rten pa yi 'byung po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// chos don bden pa la gnas nas// zhi zhing dul ba'i sems su mdzod// bdag cag byang chub ma thob bar// gegs med bar chad med pa dang*// dam tshig gnas la gnas mdzod la// byang chub thob pa'i grogs kyang mdzod// bzhi pa ni/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣā ya dzaḥsngags mthar ar+ghṃ sogs dang*/ na mas+sarba btags pas mchod gtor sbyin/ gzhi bdag gnas bdag 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs brjod/ lnga pa ni/ rang nyid rigs kyi khro bo'i nga rgyal dang bcas/ bla ma mchog gsum bden pa dang*// gsang sngags rig sngags byin brlabs kyis// bgegs kyi rigs rnams gang yin kun// skad cig gnas 'dir mchis gyur cig /ṭāk+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā sarba bighān gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ sngags de mthar sarba bighān na mas+sarba sogs btags pas mchod gtor bsngo/ gang zhig mtshan mor rgyu ba yi// 'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*// srin po sha rjen za ba dang*// sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa// ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas pa// de dang de la gtor ma ni// bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas// 'bras chan 'bras bu mang po yi// mchod sbyin 'di yis mgu byos la// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid// de ring phyin chad bskyed par bgyi// zhes bsgo/ thun mong du/ ye dharmā sogs dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya sogs chos sbyin bya/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā wa ni zhes rang rang gi gnas su gshegs/ nag phyogs pa sdod srid pas a mṛ ta sogs drag sngags kyis mtshams bcad/

shis pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// zhes pa'ang mañdzu gho ṣas bris// ༈ /bsang mchod nyung ngur bsdus pa bsod nams sprin gyi rnga gsang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru lo ke shwa rā ya/ 'dir bsang mchod mdor bsdus bya ba'i tshul la/ gnas gtsang mar mchod pa'i yo byad rnams phyag len bzhin bsham/ skyabs yul gsal btab ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis mchod sbyin bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum gyis skyabs sems dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgoms pas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa sngon du 'gro bas rang nyid lhar gsal ba ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad dkar zla ba'i steng*// hrīḥlas rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// zla mdog phyag g.yas mchod sbyin g.yon pad dkar// zhi 'dzum dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las// 'phros pa'i 'od kyis mgron rnams spyan drangs gyur// 'og min zhing dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul// khams gsum rigs drug so so'i rang gnas nas// bdud rtsi bsang gi dga' ston bzhes slad du// mchod sbyin mgron rnams spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes brjod pas/ mgron rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum lta bur gshegs par bsams la/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ de nas bsang rdzas rnams la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ yig las byung ba'i// rin chen snod du 'bru gsum zhu ba las// bsang rdzas zag med 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i sprin// mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis brlabs nas/ dngos gzhi ni/

gzod nas rnam grol 'od gsal gnyug ma'i gshis// skye 'gag gnas gsum spros pa kun bral yang*// bde chen nyams brgyar 'char ba'i rol rtsed las// ma dag snang ba dbyings su thim pa'i rtsal// phyi snod grub pa'i sa 'dzin nyams dga' ba// zhing khams rgya mtsho'i bkod pas mdzes pa'i gzhir// phun tshogs 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam mang po// 'bar ba'i me dang mnyam par sbyor ba las// byung ba'i longs spyod mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// zag med bsang mchod bdud rtsi'i sprin phung 'dis// rigs kun khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// rgya bod brgyud pa'i bla ma thugs rje can// mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba rnams// bsang ngo mchod do bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med rgyud sde dang*// 'brel ba'i yi dam zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor lha// ma lus lus pa med pa thams cad kun// bsang ngo mchod do dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// gang zhig skad cig yid la dran pas kyang*// srid dang zhi ba'i 'jigs kun skyob mdzad pa// bla med dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum// bsang ngo mchod do phan bde'i dga' ston spel// zhing skyes sngags skyes lhan cig skyes pa yi// gnas gsum dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma// ye shes las grub ḍā ki'i tshogs rnams kun// bsang ngo mchod do bar chad sel bar mdzod// bde chen thig le gcig gi rnam rol las// zhi chags khro bo'i nyams gyur mtha' klas pa'i// rdo rje'i chos srung gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs// bsang ngo mchod do phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs// khyad par grub pa'i slob dpon mtsho skyes rjes// bod khams skyong ba'i rje mor mnga' gsol ba// brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa kun// bsang ngo mchod do gangs ljongs bde skyid spel// gnyug mar gnas dang glo bur lhags pa yi// yul lha gzhi bdag bgegs rigs lan chags dang*// snying rje'i yul gyur rigs drug mgron rnams kun// bsang ngo mchod do mthun rkyen yid bzhin sgrubs// de ltar rnam bzhi'i mgron rigs thams cad la// bdud rtsi bsang gi mchod pa phul ba'i mthus// nyams grib mi gtsang gdung ba kun zhi zhing*// don gnyis dga' ston mchog tu rgyas par shog

/snod bcud srid zhi'i phyugs yang bung ba'i tshogs// rten 'brel ut+pal gsar pas yongs bsdus nas// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dge legs kyi// bkra shis snang bas rtag tu khyab gyur cig /ces brjod/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs shing*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ badz+ra muḥs mgron rnams gshegs/ sbyin pa rgya chen gyur pa 'di yis ni// sogs kyis bsngo smon dang*/ ston mchog dam pa sogs shis pa brjod pa ji ltar rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// zhes pa'ang dpal e waṃ chos ldan thar pa chen po'i grong khyer nas mdo khams shar gyi phyogs su bskyod pa la nye ba'i dus kyi dge mtshan phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin rig pa 'dzin pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos shar mar spel ba'o// sarba dā ka l+yā ṇaṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /tsha gsur gyi cho ga bzhugs/ bla ma lhag pa'i lhar btud de// tsha gsur gtong 'dod 'di skad do// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// gzhan don byang chub spyod pa spyad// sngon 'gro'o// bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang gsal// snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros// mchod yul rgya mtsho gzhi bdag dang*// 'gro ba rigs drug lan chags bgegs// dri za bar dor gnas pa bcas// thams cad tshur spyon 'dir bzhugs shig /spyan 'dren no// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos kun stong pa'i ngang nyid las// gsur mchod 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// ci 'dod rtag par 'jo ba'i sprin// zhing kun khyab par rgyas gyur cig /byin rlabs so// sam+bha ra lan bdun gyis bsngos la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor yongs khengs pa// 'dod yon gsur gyi mchod sprin 'di// bla ma yi dam lha yi tshogs// rgyal ba sras slob thams cad dang*// bstan srung nor sbyin bcas la 'bul// yul lha gzhi bdag gnas bdag dang*// rab dga' zur phud lnga pa sogs// zas su dri la bza' rnams dang*// ma gyur rigs drug sems can dang*// lan chags sha 'khon bgegs kyi rigs// shi nas ring por ma lon pa'i// srid pa bar do'i sems can bcas// kun la sbyin no thob par gyur// mchod sbyin no// mchod yul rgya mtsho mnyes gyur nas// bdag gzhan phyi nang bar chad zhi// tshe blo bsod nams longs spyod rgyas// skye 'gro chags shing 'dun pa dang*// dgra bgegs gdug pa tshar gcod mdzod// sbyin gnas 'jig rten skyong tshogs kyis// nyes srung legs pa'i phyogs la sbyor// bar do'i 'gro rnams 'jigs skrag dang*// 'khrul snang sdug bsngal kun las thar// 'gro drug srid pa'i sdug bsngal las// rnam grol sangs rgyas thob par shog
